in_marathi.name: Kalandi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalandi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kalandi is the name of a Hindu goddess, a form of Goddess Saraswati. She is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, learning, and arts. In Hindu mythology, Kalandi is often depicted holding a veena (a musical instrument) and is considered to be the source of creative arts and learning.
